SELECT event_no AS eventNo, event_type AS eventType, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, biz_no AS bizNo, event_topic AS eventTopic, downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, publish_status AS publishStatus, publish_status_type AS publishStatusType, payment_success_http_stage AS paymentSuccessHttpStage, retry_count AS retryCount, DATE_FORMAT(last_published_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastPublishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(next_retry_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS nextRetryAt, last_republish_operator AS lastRepublishOperator, DATE_FORMAT(last_republished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRepublishedAt, event_payload AS eventPayload, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_event
ORDER BY retry_count
ORDER BY next_retry_at
ORDER BY created_at
ASC
DESC
LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'DEAD_LETTER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deadLetterEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'UNKNOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknownEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status IN ('FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedOrDeadLetterCount, COUNT(DISTINCT downstream_system) AS distinctDownstreamCount, SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'FAILED' AND next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_at <= NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dueRetryEventCount, SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paymentSuccessEventCount, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(last_published_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestPublishedAt FROM t_payment_event

SELECT event_no AS eventNo, event_type AS eventType, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, biz_no AS bizNo, event_topic AS eventTopic, downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, publish_status AS publishStatus, publish_status_type AS publishStatusType, payment_success_http_stage AS paymentSuccessHttpStage, retry_count AS retryCount, DATE_FORMAT(last_published_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastPublishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(next_retry_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS nextRetryAt, last_republish_operator AS lastRepublishOperator, DATE_FORMAT(last_republished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRepublishedAt, event_payload AS eventPayload, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_event
ORDER BY retry_count
ORDER BY next_retry_at
ORDER BY created_at
ASC
DESC
LIMIT 1001
SELECT event_no FROM t_payment_event WHERE publish_status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT event_no FROM t_payment_event WHERE (publish_status = 'FAILED' OR (publish_status = 'PENDING' AND event_type IN ('PAYMENT_SUCCESS', 'REFUND_SUBMIT'))) AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT event_no AS eventNo, event_type AS eventType, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, biz_no AS bizNo, event_topic AS eventTopic, downstream_system AS downstreamSystem, publish_status AS publishStatus, publish_status_type AS publishStatusType, payment_success_http_stage AS paymentSuccessHttpStage, retry_count AS retryCount, DATE_FORMAT(last_published_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastPublishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(next_retry_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS nextRetryAt, last_republish_operator AS lastRepublishOperator, DATE_FORMAT(last_republished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastRepublishedAt, event_payload AS eventPayload, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_payment_event WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT event_no AS eventNo, event_type AS eventType, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, biz_no AS bizNo, publish_status AS publishStatus, payment_success_http_stage AS paymentSuccessHttpStage, retry_count AS retryCount FROM t_payment_event WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_payment_event SET publish_status = 'SUCCESS', publish_status_type = 'success', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_published_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = NULL WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND publish_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER', 'UNKNOWN')

UPDATE t_payment_event SET payment_success_http_stage = 'CLEARING_ACCEPTED' WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' AND payment_success_http_stage = 'PENDING' AND publish_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER')

UPDATE t_payment_event SET payment_success_http_stage = 'COMPLETED' WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND event_type = 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS' AND payment_success_http_stage = 'CLEARING_ACCEPTED' AND publish_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER')

UPDATE t_payment_event SET publish_status = 'FAILED', publish_status_type = 'danger', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_published_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND publish_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE t_payment_event SET publish_status = 'DEAD_LETTER', publish_status_type = 'danger', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_published_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = NULL WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND publish_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER')

UPDATE t_payment_event SET publish_status = 'UNKNOWN', publish_status_type = 'warn', retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_published_at = NOW(), next_retry_at = NULL WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND publish_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED', 'DEAD_LETTER')
UPDATE t_payment_event SET last_republish_operator = #{operator}, last_republished_at = NOW() WHERE event_no = #{eventNo} AND publish_status = 'SUCCESS'
